programs.title: Stefano Noferini: Digital Art Experience - Florence (Italy)
programs.desc: The connection and the perfect fusion of music and art, trigger the greatest emotions and feelings. The synchronicity aligns with the heartbeat and therefore, an immersive experience is born, from the inside out.

programs.desc: In the mountains of Baadaran in the south of Lebanon lies an abandoned airport, the perfect playground for a party. Local heavyweights Whoisbibz and Audioblend give us something to dance about.

programs.title: Niconé: Ritter Butzke on Tour - Berlin (Germany)

programs.title: Magda: Up Festival - Prague (Czech Republic)
programs.desc: Magda's realm as an artist spans far beyond the typical role played by DJs and producers. She takes over the stage for an hour of amazing minimal vibes. Stand up, turn it up, and enjoy!

programs.title: Heidi: Space
programs.desc: Always playing the hottest tracks in her bass-heavy house style, Heidi has been rocking dance floors worldwide for over a decade as she did at The Revolution, Space a few weeks ago making everyone - including Cox - dance.

programs.title: Stephen Popov: Solar Summer 2022 - Burgas (Bulgaria)

programs.title: Altern8 ----- THE ACID EXPERIMENT, Birmingham (UK)
programs.desc: Altern8, pioneer duo of the early UK raves, represented here by Mark Archer took over the Lab11 at The Acid Experiment. This set is influenced by real acid house vibes.

programs.title: Away to: Byblos with Colyn - By Late Knights and Creative State - Beirut (Lebanon)
